examples.title: Example 1: Linking the Title Bar and Toolbar with Scrollable Components
examples.description: This example shows how to bind a NavDestination component to scrollable containers so that scrolling in the scrollable containers triggers the animations for showing or hiding the title bar and toolbar of the NavDestination component.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting a Custom Transitions for the NavDestination Component
examples.description: The following example demonstrates how to set a custom transition animation for the NavDestination component using customTransition.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting System Transition Animations for the NavDestination Component
examples.description: The following example demonstrates how to set system transition animations using systemTransition with Fade, Explode, SlideBottom, and SlideRight effects.

examples.title: Example 4: Configuring Display Orientation and Status Bar and Navigation Bar Visibility
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to configure each NavDestination component with specific display orientations and control the visibility of the status bar and navigation bar.

examples.title: Example 5: Handling NavDestination onActive and onInActive Lifecycle Events
examples.description: Starting from API version 17, the NavDestination component includes the onActive and onInactive lifecycle events. This example demonstrates various triggering scenarios for the onActive and onInactive lifecycle callbacks.
